themes.name: Agentic AI development
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of performing tasks autonomously, often in software development, research, and complex workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, acting as pair programmers or code generators.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles about platforms, tools, and techniques that leverage AI to facilitate and enhance the research process.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or media into concise summaries for quicker comprehension.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to automate, enhance, or analyze usability testing processes and user feedback.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, recruitment, skills, and the overall future of work.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Covers platforms designed specifically for AI research, development, and experimentation, often offering specialized tools and environments.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on studies, findings, and concerns related to the behavior, capabilities, and impact of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Articles discussing the application of AI in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to UX/UI design.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles comparing, reviewing, and assessing the effectiveness of various AI tools for different applications.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
